author: (Dall, 1881)

note.en: A large worm snail that lives deeper than 37 m on hard ground; one museum record and not reachable by snorkelers.
note.es: Un caracol gusano grande que vive a más de 37 m sobre fondo duro; un registro de museo y no alcanzable para quienes hacen snorkel.

evidence: GBIF: 1 records in the region (specimens and observations)

marks.en: Loosely coiled, irregular tube shell with a long narrow slit along its side, often embedded in sponges.
marks.es: Concha en tubo irregular y flojamente enrollado con una larga ranura estrecha a lo largo, a menudo incrustada en esponjas.
